Featherweight Haul.name: Featherweight Haul
Featherweight Haul.description: The user lays hands on whatever pins someone, a fallen slab, a steel beam or a car, and takes its weight away without letting it drift, so a single rescuer can lift it clear or swing it aside. Injured people the user touches float level and steady and can be guided out by hand without jostling a broken bone or an injured spine; all of it stays weightless until the user releases it. Strain: moderate.
